## How to use this collection

1. Choose a category and open a prompt card.
2. Check its source, required reference images, model variant, and test status.
3. Copy the original prompt and use the recorded settings. If a verified generation link is provided, you can open it directly.

[Official model announcement](https://openai.com/index/introducing-images-2-6/) · [Official model documentation](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-generation)

## Sources & contributions

Each entry keeps its original source and separates collected examples from our own test results. Prompts remain in their original language. Image and prompt reuse terms are recorded per entry.

Have an example to add? Follow the contribution guide and include the original post, prompt, and preview credit.

[Contribute a prompt](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Maintainer guide](docs/FILLING_GUIDE.zh-CN.md)

The repository code and original documentation use the MIT license. Third-party prompts and images retain their own terms.
